title: Kenyan Passion Fruit Pudding
description: A buttery and glassy jelly like Kenyan dish featuring passion fruit pulp, perfect for a sick day, made using papillote and ovo vegetarian friendly ingredients. This dessert is a classic Kenyan treat that is easy to make and fun to eat.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften.
In a medium saucepan, combine the passion fruit pulp, sugar, and 1 cup of water, and bring to a boil over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture has reduced slightly.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the softened gelatin until it is fully dissolved.
Add the butter, beaten eggs, and vanilla extract to the saucepan, and stir until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Pour the mixture into small individual serving cups or a large serving dish, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until set.
Serve the pudding chilled, garnished with additional passion fruit pulp if desired.
